$why: Operator, 2026-10-06: one plan for the story, written once and passed to every codeline as a shared artefact.
The first detective writes it (detective-overall-plan); the detective of every later codeline is given it here and
investigates its own codeline's part, rather than planning the story again from one codeline's view.
2026-10-06, real-model rounds: given a plan that gave it no change, a consumer lane marked its lock file and locale files as requiring change.
description: Composed into the code-graph detective's prescription once the story has an overall plan: work this codeline's part of it, and say plainly where this codeline's code contradicts it.
body:
THIS STORY ALREADY HAS ITS PLAN, written by the first investigation for every codeline it is worked in. You are investigating codeline "__THIS_CODELINE__": locate the fix sites for ITS part of the plan below, and nothing the plan gives to another codeline.
__OVERALL_PLAN__
Where the plan gives this codeline no change of its own, none of your fix sites requires a change — receiving the provider's release (manifest, lock file, install) is not this codeline's work in this story.
The plan is the story's, not a lead to re-derive. Where this codeline's own code contradicts it — a use of the changed code the plan does not list, a part that cannot be done as stated — say so in the fix site's reason, naming what you found; do not write a different plan.
